back: A rectangular array of numbers arranged in rows and columns. Denoted by capital letters. Order m × n has m rows and n columns.
A = [aij] where aij is element in i-th row and j-th column. Order written as m × n.
Zero matrix: all elements 0. Identity matrix: 1s on diagonal, 0 elsewhere. Symmetric: Aᵀ = A. Skew-symmetric: Aᵀ = −A.
Defined if A and B have same order. Element-wise: (A + B)ij = aij + bij.
kA multiplies each element by k: (kA)ij = k · aij.
AB defined if A (m×n) and B (n×p). Result is m × p. (AB)ij = ∑k aik bkj. Note: AB ≠ BA in general.
Aᵀ obtained by interchanging rows and columns. (Aᵀ)ij = aji. Properties: (Aᵀ)ᵀ = A, (kA)ᵀ = kAᵀ, (A+B)ᵀ = Aᵀ+Bᵀ, (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ.
Square matrix A where Aᵀ = A. Example: [1 2; 2 3].
Square matrix A where Aᵀ = −A. Diagonal elements must be 0. Example: [0 1; −1 0].
Row matrix → column matrix on transpose. Identity: I·A = A·I = A. Distributive: A(B + C) = AB + AC.
